name: α-propyltryptamine
summary: α-Propyltryptamine (APT, αPT, or α-PT) is a chemical compound of the tryptamine and α-alkyltryptamine families. It is the α-propyl derivative of tryptamine and is a higher homologue of α-methyltryptamine (AMT) and α-ethyltryptamine (AET). The compound was briefly mentioned by Alexander Shulgin in his 1997 book TiHKAL (Tryptamines I Have Known and Loved).

uses.en: It is an obscure research compound with no established use.
uses.zh: 它是鮮為人知的研究用化合物，沒有確立的用途。
uses.zhHans: 它是鲜为人知的研究用化合物，没有确立的用途。

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Related α-alkyltryptamines such as αMT and αET can cause nausea, muscle tension, a racing heart, overheating, anxiety and restlessness, and can raise the risk of serotonin syndrome, which can be life-threatening.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。相關的α-烷基色胺類（例如αMT與αET）可能引起噁心、肌肉緊繃、心跳急促、體溫過高、焦慮與坐立不安，也可能提高血清素症候群的風險，這種狀況可能危及生命。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。相关的α-烷基色胺类（例如αMT与αET）可能引起恶心、肌肉紧绷、心跳急促、体温过高、焦虑与坐立不安，也可能提高血清素症候群的风险，这种状况可能危及生命。

fact.en: It is the next step up from αMT and αET, with a three-carbon chain in the α position. Alexander Shulgin mentioned it only briefly in TiHKAL.
fact.zh: 它是αMT與αET之後的下一步，在α位置上接了三個碳的鏈。Alexander Shulgin在《TiHKAL》中只簡短提到它。
fact.zhHans: 它是αMT与αET之后的下一步，在α位置上接了三个碳的链。Alexander Shulgin在《TiHKAL》中只简短提到它。
